jcr:description: The legacy continues. Cephalomedullary nailing system for the treatment of intertrochanteric fractures as well as a wide range of proximal femur fractures and associated femoral shaft fractures.

largeheadline.line1:
Gamma4 

Hip Fracture 
Nailing System

We aren't proven because we have a legacy.

We have a legacy because we are proven.
largeheadline.line2: Cephalomedullary nailing (CMN) system for the treatment of intertrochanteric fractures as well as a wide range of proximal femur fractures and associated femoral shaft fractures.

largeheadline_copy_c.line1: Gamma4 is a comprehensive femoral intramedullary nailing (IMN) system
largeheadline_copy_c.line2: The nailing system is the result of over 34 years of continuous innovation and clinical history.

text.text:
Trochanteric Nail surgical animation

The Gamma4 Trochanteric Nail is a hip fracture solution for fixation of stable and unstable intertrochantric fractures.

text_copy.text:
Intermediate Nail surgical animation

The Gamma4 Intermediate Nail is a hip fracture solution for fixation of stable and unstable intertrochantric fractures.

text.text:
Long Nail surgical animation

The Gamma4 Long Nail is a hip fracture solution for stable and unstable intertrochanteric fractures and femoral shaft fractures.

text.text:
Redefined 
nail design

  • Short, intermediate and long nail options
  • Pre-inserted and cannulated set screw
  • SOMA designed1 
    • Shortened proximal body by 5mm 
    • Chamfered distal tip  
    • 3-degree anterior bend for Long and Intermediate Nails 
    • Length dependent RoC Long Nails 
  • Wide distal diameter range: 
    • 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, & 15mm
  • Lag Screw and RC Lag Screw options

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Gamma4 Hip Fracture Nailing System Hip Nail Precision Pin

text_copy.text:
Streamlined
workflow

  • Precision Pin™ ∅3.9mm, has a drill tip with 5mm threads
    • Measure to the tip of Precision Pin™ 
    • With the Precision Pin™ the potential for skiving is reduced by 66% compared to your standard ∅3.2 K-wire2
    • 3.7x more resistant to pullout2
  • Two-piece Targeting Sleeve is designed to provide up to 15mm of compression

text_copy_copy.text:
Integrated
instrument platform

  • We have a streamlined portfolio where we utilize the existing IMN Basic set
    • All nails have distal targeting
       
  • Reduced inventory 

  • Lag Screw measurement off Precision SleeveTM 

  • Single Lag Screw Driver
  • Optional Anti-Rotation Clip and sleeve
